questions.question: A renter reports that the gear shifter came out of the transmission box when shifting into reverse. Which recall campaigns for that vehicle were filed by a company other than Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing?

chunks.quote: THE GEAR SHIFTER CAME OUT OF THE TRANSMISSION BOX.

questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT r.NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r JOIN complaints c ON c.product.productModel = r.Model WHERE c.odiNumber = 11204698 AND r.Manufacturer <> 'Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing'
questions.note: The complaint is 11204698 about the 2019 Toyota RAV4. 19V244000 was filed by Gulf States Toyota, Inc. and 19V503000 by Southeast Toyota Distributors, LLC; the other six RAV4 recalls were filed by Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing.

questions.question: How many owner complaints concern a vehicle that has a recall campaign for its back-up or rearview camera?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT count(DISTINCT c.odiNumber) FROM complaints c JOIN r ON r.Model = c.product.productModel WHERE r.Component LIKE 'BACK OVER PREVENTION%'
questions.note: Camera recalls: 19V576000 (2019 Toyota RAV4, back-up camera) and 25V695000 (2015 Ford Escape, rearview camera); each vehicle has five complaints.

questions.question: How many recall campaigns did NHTSA receive in the same calendar year as the model year of the vehicle they affect?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT count(*) FROM r JOIN vehicles v ON v.model = r.Model WHERE year(strptime(r.ReportReceivedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')) = v.model_year

questions.question: Which vehicle has the most owner complaints that list the power train among their components?
questions.sql: SELECT product.productModel FROM complaints WHERE components LIKE '%POWER TRAIN%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: RAV4 has two (11204698, 11209676); the Rogue (11030208) and the Escape (10692693) have one each.

questions.question: Which complaints were filed on the same day as the incident they report?
questions.sql: SELECT odiNumber FROM complaints WHERE dateOfIncident = dateComplaintFiled

questions.question: Which recall campaigns affecting the 2017 Nissan Rogue concern its electrical system?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r WHERE Model = 'ROGUE' AND Component LIKE 'ELECTRICAL SYSTEM%'
questions.note: Judged by the recall's component field. 21V839000 describes a damaged engine harness and a blown fuse, but its component is ENGINE AND ENGINE COOLING:ENGINE:ENGINE CONTROL MODULE (ECU/ECM), so it does not count.

questions.question: Which recall campaign warns that a cracked passenger seat sensor can make the air bags deploy unintentionally?

chunks.quote: The front passenger seat weight sensor may crack and short circuit, which can cause the air bags to deploy unintentionally during a crash.

questions.note: 16V244000 (2017 Nissan Rogue) has a similar occupant classification component but the opposite failure: the passenger air bag "may be turned off and not deploy".

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with a gas gauge stuck showing a full tank?

chunks.quote: MY GAS GAUGE IS SHOWING FULL AFTER FILL UP BUT NOW IS NOT MOVEING AND SAYS I STILL HAVE A FULL TANK

questions.note: The 2019 Toyota RAV4 complaint 11221492 says the opposite: "MY GAS GAUGE DOES NOT INDICATE FULL"; that denied mention must not count.

questions.question: What will dealers do under recall 23V093000?

expected.text: Insert a spacer into the key slot of the jackknife key, free of charge.

chunks.quote: Dealers will insert a spacer into the key slot of the jackknife key, free of charge.

questions.question: From what speed, in miles per hour, does the owner in complaint 11229137 say the wind noise can be heard well?

chunks.quote: WHEN YOU GET UP TO 50 MILES PER HOUR IS WHEN U CAN HEAR IT GOOD.
